provenance: Partial metrics retained from terminal output before the request to preserve pilots. The original full pilot JSON had already been overwritten by the final rerun; this is not a complete historical artifact.

initial_failed_run.failure: The subtractive mean/difference exact-exchange expression generated a negative tiny population and was rejected by occupation_array while evaluating reconstructed_energy. No clipping was introduced; the algebraically equivalent convex expm1 expression replaced it.

pre_boundary_correction_successful_pilot.interface_policy: The common upper node was excluded, dropping a valid left half-cell; the final implementation includes its left quadrature weight and keeps the private tail separate.
pre_boundary_correction_successful_pilot.qualification: Diagnostic history only; excluded from the acceptance certificate. No original full figures or CSVs are asserted to survive.
